ai_summary: Valor Estate Limited (formerly D B Realty Limited) has significantly progressed its material International Convention Centre and Hotel project in Goa by incorporating a wholly-owned SPV, depositing a ₹57.90 Crore Performance Bank Guarantee, and executing the Concession Agreement with the Government of Goa. This Design, Build, Finance, Operate and Transfer (DBFOT) project is expected to create substantial long-term value; however, the sizable PBG underscores the significant financial commitment and inherent development risks associated with such large-scale ventures.
